name: Mandelbulb 3D Attractor
description: A WebGL2 ray-marched Mandelbulb strange-attractor that grows through phases as the fractal power n increases. The Anthropic team's favourite first run.

name: 3D Starling Murmuration
description: A real-time 3D flock of starlings from three local rules (separation, alignment, cohesion). Full multi-agent replay — coders, testers, finalizer — then the Enhancement loop adds topological neighbours, a predator, and density-wave shimmer.

name: Quaternion Julia Attractor
description: A ray-marched 3D quaternion Julia strange attractor (z → z² + c). Short multi-agent replay where the Testers catch a resolution-scaling bug and the Coder fixes it — ending in the interactive emerald attractor.

name: Conway's Game of Life
description: Conway's Game of Life with a dynamically growing grid (no edge effects), step + auto playback, and jump-to-generation — plus Game of Life as a Turing machine (logic gates) and Game of Life playing Game of Life.

name: Flow-Field Particles
description: Generative-art particle system driven by a 2D curl-noise flow field. 5 palettes, real-time controls, interactive pointer disturbance.
